migration_steps.activity: Establish PQC migration program governance, assign a technical lead, and document the DoD mandate requirements (NIST-standardized ML-KEM and ML-DSA only) and the 2027 deadline.
prerequisites: Copy of DoD mandate and acceptance criteria

migration_steps.activity: Perform cryptographic inventory of the IKEv2/IPsec VPN estate: identify all gateways, clients, firmware versions, RSA-2048 and DH Group 14 usage, certificate authorities, and PSK usage.

Evaluate the vendor's PSK appliance claim against DoD requirements; document that PSK with 256-bit entropy is not vulnerable to Shor's algorithm but is not a NIST-standardized PQC algorithm and does not satisfy the ML-KEM/ML-DSA mandate.

Issue formal RFI to current VPN vendor and alternative vendors requesting evidence of ML-KEM and ML-DSA support in IKEv2/IPsec, including firmware versions, interoperability statements, and certification status.
Select a PQC-capable VPN solution that supports ML-KEM for key establishment and ML-DSA for authentication, or confirm a vendor roadmap with contractual delivery milestones before 2027.
prerequisites: Vendor evidence of ML-KEM/ML-DSA support verified

migration_steps.activity: Procure PQC-capable VPN hardware/software and professional services for design, integration, and training.
prerequisites: Vendor selected with confirmed PQC support

migration_steps.activity: Design hybrid IKEv2/IPsec configuration using ML-KEM for key establishment alongside classical DH, and ML-DSA for certificate-based authentication, with fallback and rollback procedures.
Conduct non-production lab testing of ML-KEM and ML-DSA in IKEv2/IPsec, including interoperability with DoD endpoints, performance impact, and certificate chain validation.
prerequisites: DoD test endpoints or test CA available

migration_steps.activity: Train network team on PQC concepts, ML-KEM/ML-DSA roles, hybrid IKEv2 configuration, and operational procedures.
Obtain DoD approval of the PQC migration design and test results, and schedule production cutover outside the Dec 1–Jan 15 change freeze.
Execute production pilot migration of a limited set of VPN gateways to ML-KEM/ML-DSA hybrid configuration during an approved maintenance window after the change freeze.
Complete full production rollout of PQC-capable VPN across all contractor sites and verify DoD interoperability.
Conduct post-migration validation, update security documentation, and establish continuous monitoring for cryptographic algorithm compliance.

blockers.resolution_required: Select a VPN vendor with confirmed ML-KEM and ML-DSA support, or obtain contractual commitment with delivery before 2027 and DoD acceptance.

algorithm_roles.ML-KEM: Post-quantum key establishment (encapsulation) for IKEv2 key exchange, replacing or hybridizing DH Group 14 to protect against Shor's algorithm.
algorithm_roles.ML-DSA: Post-quantum digital signatures for IKEv2 authentication and certificate-based identity, replacing RSA-2048 signatures to protect against Shor's algorithm.
